name: agentgit
description: Coordination layer for coding agents: a ledger of what is in flight, shared contracts with versions, and one verdict before every write.

scripts.test: npm run lint:encoding && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/daemon/tsconfig.json
